title: DynaKit – Basic Titanium
description:
In this handy little kit you will find most of everything you need to keep your vapcap in good working order.
Both types of o-rings are included as well as 3 titanium CCD screens. And to help keep things feeling smooth and also to rejuvenate any wood parts, dynawax is included.
When it comes to cleaning out your vapcap we have you covered with 5 hard bristled cotton pipe cleaners.
And final 1 fat mouthpiece and 2 standard storage tubes make up the stainless basic dynakit.
Included
2 x Green Storage Tube
1 x DynaWax
3 x Condenser O-rings
5 x High Temp O-rings
3 x Titanium CCD Screens
1 x Fat Mouthpiece
5 x Hard Bristled Cotton Pipe Cleaners
